name: Clogau
known_for: Jewelry Made With Rare Welsh Gold

prices.note: products.json (GBP) all-charms, 10 products: 9 regular-price available, all £99 (Insignia Sterling Silver charms: Welsh Dragon, Heart, Daffodil, Tree of Life, Cariad, Oak Leaf...). Each with 9ct rose gold detailing; 'Every piece of Clogau jewellery contains rare Welsh gold'; designed to fit the Insignia charm bracelet, necklace and choker.

notes: About: in 1989 William Roberts found the abandoned Clogau St David's gold mine at Bontddu in Snowdonia; the brand captures that Welsh gold in its jewellery.

Shipping: international delivery £14.99 for all orders (UK free over £150); meta.json ships_to_countries includes US, CA, GB, AU. Returns: 30-day no-quibble money-back guarantee, unworn in original packaging; earrings, engraved and bespoke excluded.
